title: Nutty Bitter Vietnamese Chervil Rolled Rice Cakes
description: A weeknight pescatarian-friendly dish featuring chervil, mother-sauce-base, in a flaky banh-cuon form.
instructions: Soak the rice flour in water for at least 30 minutes.
Combine the mother sauce base, grated ginger, grated onion, nutritional yeast, sesame oil, shrimp paste, and fish sauce in a kazan cauldron.
Bring the mixture to a simmer over medium heat, whisking constantly.
Add the soaked rice flour and water mixture to the cauldron and stir until combined.
Continue to simmer for 5 minutes, stirring frequently.
Transfer the mixture to a work surface and knead for 10 minutes.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each into a thin circle.
Brush the edges of the dough with water and fold the dough into a cylinder shape.
Serve the rolled rice cakes with the mother sauce base for dipping.
